steps.en: Notices due for the 2nd driver letter are picked up each night
steps.id: Notice yang jatuh tempo untuk surat driver ke-2 dipilih setiap malam

steps.en: Only drivers with a usable postal address are included
steps.id: Hanya driver dengan alamat pos yang bisa dipakai yang disertakan

steps.en: A letter data file for the print vendor is generated
steps.id: File data surat untuk vendor cetak dibuat

steps.en: The file is sent to the vendor for printing and postage
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor untuk dicetak dan diposkan
steps.why_en: The production settings in the repo block uploads to the vendor, so the file is not delivered.
steps.why_id: Pengaturan produksi di repo memblokir unggahan ke vendor, sehingga file tidak terkirim.

steps.en: After delivery the notice moves on to the next reminder stage
steps.id: Setelah pengiriman, notice pindah ke tahap pengingat berikutnya
steps.why_en: The stage moves on even when the file was blocked from reaching the vendor in production.
steps.why_id: Tahap tetap maju meskipun file diblokir sebelum sampai ke vendor di produksi.
